title: One selection function for every MILP solver
heading: CP-SAT Needs Integers, and Rounds a Continuous Model Without Warning
cases: HiGHS, SCIP and CP-SAT each return the best plan's value and the same sorted project ids
the returned projects cost no more than the budget
a must-do project is in the plan even when its value per dollar is poor
the value is that of whole projects, not of a fractional plan worth more
GLOP or PDLP raises ValueError naming the solver, before any solve
a budget below the must-do projects' cost raises RuntimeError naming the termination reason
